## About this coursework

This folder contains source files found in both `Documents/DS250` and `Documents/DS250 - BYUI`. Files are archived with a `.txt` suffix so Quarto treats them as downloadable source instead of executing homework during the portfolio build.

## Files

The complete archive is available in the [DS 250 assignment folder on GitHub](https://github.com/fandre01/aboutme/tree/main/coursework/ds-250/assignments).
